The '''Enterprise Collection Remastered''' is the 37th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 26 October 2018. The set consists of 18 virtual cards. This set is part of the current ''Enterprise Block'' consisting of cards from [[Broken Bow]], [[Pre-Warp Pack]], [[Live Long and Prosper (expansion)|Live Long and Prosper]], [[Cold Front (expansion)|Cold Front]], and [[Enterprise Collection Remastered (expansion)|Enterprise Collection Remastered]] expansion sets.

'''Enterprise Collection Remastered''' features refreshed versions of the eighteen (18) cards originally printed in Decipher's '''[[Enterprise Collection]]'''. The refreshed versions of the cards include the missing 22nd century icon from the Decipher expansion set as well as additional errata.
